claims.text: Spot $449.38 at ~$505B market cap, ~7.9x forward EPS vs semi peers at 25-35x
Q2 FY26: revenue $23.86B (+196% YoY), 75% non-GAAP GM, $12.20 non-GAAP EPS — obliterated the guide
Q3 FY26: revenue $41.46B (+~346% YoY, ~16% beat), non-GAAP EPS $25.11 (+24% beat, 7th straight beat), non-GAAP GM ~84.6%, op margin ~81.2%
Q4 FY26 guide: revenue $50.0B ±1.0B (~15% above cons), non-GAAP GM ~86%, non-GAAP EPS $31 ±1 → ~$124 annualized run-rate
DRAM $31.3B (~76% of rev), ASP +low-60s% QoQ; NAND $9.9B (~24%), ASP +mid-single-digit% QoQ — the beat was price, not volume

Profitability inversion confirmed by CEO Mehrotra: "non-HBM DRAM margins ... have become exceptionally robust and in periods exceeded HBM margins"; at Q2 FY26 the all-non-HBM MCBU ran 79% GM vs HBM-heavy CMBU 74%
Supply wall, Mehrotra: "no line of sight on when supply will catch demand; new fabs won't deliver meaningful output until fiscal 2028"
16 strategic customer agreements: ~$100B minimum revenue commitments, $22B upfront customer cash, ~20% of DRAM / ~1/3 of NAND volume — "a fundamental transformation of our business model"
Sole LPDRAM supplier to NVIDIA data-center GPUs; LP5X SOCAMM2 shipping in volume; 256GB DDR5 RDIMM (1-gamma) sampling — a second sole-sourced data-center socket beyond HBM
Exited Crucial consumer DRAM business, removing ~25% of global consumer DRAM capacity as wafers redirect to HBM/enterprise
